hardware_comparison.note: The other arms of this catalog store model name, core count, online cpu list, and memory. Family, stepping, caches, and kernel were not stored there, so this file does not claim the machines are the same.

prior_arm.note: Those counts are from the earlier eon-classic arm. Force-call counts, convergence, and saddle energies are the quantities to set beside that arm. Wall time is cross-session context only.

rgsaddle.role: The eon-classic arm runs eonclient with potential morse_pt. librgsaddle is unused, so this rerun does not build it.

run.config_ini:
[Main]
job = akmc
temperature = 700
finite_difference = 0.001
random_seed = 20261016

[Potential]
potential = morse_pt

[Optimizer]
opt_method = lbfgs
convergence_metric = norm
converged_force = 0.001
max_move = 0.2
max_iterations = 1000

[AKMC]
confidence = 1.1
thermally_accessible_window = 99999
confidence_scheme = old

[Communicator]
type = local
num_jobs = 1
number_of_CPUs = 1
client_path = <eon-prefix>/bin/eonclient

[Dimer]
improved = false
opt_method = sd
converged_angle = 5.0
rotations_max = 20
rotations_min = 1
finite_angle = 0.005

[LBFGS]
lbfgs_memory = 20
lbfgs_inverse_curvature = 0.01
lbfgs_auto_scale = true

[Prefactor]
default_value = 5000000000000.0

[Process Search]
minimize_first = true

[Saddle Search]
min_mode_method = dimer
displace_listed_atom_weight = 1
displace_atom_list = 0,1,2,3,4,5,6
displace_radius = 3.3
displace_magnitude = 0.1
max_energy = 5.0
max_iterations = 1000
converged_force = 0.001

spec.prior_ref: No optbench branch or pull request at this fetch contains the aa6dd937 campaign. The protocol files are the eon-classic products of the patch titled feat: record the aa6dd937 pt-island catalog.
spec.prior_v2: The aa6dd937 eon-classic arm has no v2 file.
